ev.q: In the town of Dillon, Texas, football is life
follows a high school football team in the fictional town of Dillon
a small, close-knit community in rural West Texas
It features an ensemble cast led by Kyle Chandler and Connie Britton
deep exploration of its central characters
Kyle Chandler and Connie Britton also scored multiple nominations
portraying new high school football coach Eric Taylor and his wife Tami Taylor
lauded for its realistic portrayal of Middle America
with the Landry and Tyra murder plot being particularly panned by critics
Season two reviews were considerably less positive than for the first
The series ended its run on The 101 Network on February 9, 2011, after five seasons
